reviews.reason: The related-capability searches found eat and gather, but neither prepares ingredients into a reusable prepared-food product; probe performs observations or small trials rather than meal production. Develop the smallest feasible general food-preparation operation: portion and hand-combine already edible ingredients without heat or equipment. This can make a substantial meal from Ivo's actual berries without inventing tools, fuel, cooking benefits or mastery. Unavailable mechanisms remain in the current-conversation development handoff, not a permanent rejection. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Ivo must individually complete one simulation round of study through learn after implementation; request, review, naming, registration and study/mastery award no experiential benefit. Preparation changes food organization, not its nutritional potency. Any pleasure or satisfaction must be tied to an actual personally applicable event, principally eating acceptable food, not merely requesting or producing a labeled meal. Apply the established experience policy in code: use substantialNutrition=8 and mealWindow=10 on actual consumption, deduplicate raw ingredients and their prepared form as the same nutritional event, and do not stack preparation and eating rewards for the same event. Ivo currently has satiety 92.4, so nominal meal nutrition does not guarantee equivalent usable nourishment or an additional comfort benefit. Any supported meal pleasure is brief, capped and subject to the ten-round window; maintained satisfaction may use the established mentalRate 0.04 and mentalDecay 0.002 only within its existing bounded account and applicability rules. If no executable bounded reward rule exists, defer that reward mechanism to the same handoff rather than mint an unspecified bonus. Familiar legitimate meal preparation and eating may qualify without novelty. Verified new information, including informative failure, may qualify only when an actual observation establishes it, not for invoking the operation. Physical comfort remains capped at 10. Do not alter protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions, and do not reduce basic nutrition for low mood.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable preparation-start, progress, pause, resume, cancel, failure and completion events, with actor, work ID, actual input references, quantities, position, progress and timestamp. Completion must reference the created product and occur only after successful atomic input conversion. Provide reusable visual metadata for work-in-progress and prepared-food stacks: component food, mode cold-combined, ingredient resource IDs and proportions, quantity, condition, state, progress and a derived ingredient palette. Show hand preparation only during real work; show the completed meal only when it exists. Do not depict a bowl, utensils, fire, steam or cooked texture without corresponding real objects and processes. Interrupted, failed or incomplete work remains visibly unfinished; eating visuals and effects require a real eat event. Visual labels and presentation confer no safety, nutrition, experience or mastery.
reviews.specification: Implement a general Prepare food operation parameterized by ingredient stack IDs, quantities and supported preparation mode, initially cold portion/combine. Before implementation, reconcile the retained registry search results with full implementation contracts in the existing development handoff; if an equivalent parameterized operation exists, reuse its code and record that dependency rather than implement a duplicate. Reuse inventory transfer, food properties, decay, work scheduling and eat contracts. Inputs must be real, accessible, actor-owned edible ingredients with applicable known safety evidence; nontoxicity alone does not establish that an otherwise inedible material is ready to eat. Cold preparation requires usable hands and the ability to handle the selected food, but no vessel, water, fuel or fabricated tool. No washing, cutting, heating, sterilization, detoxification, preservation or digestibility improvement is implied. Other modes require their actual implemented mechanisms and physical prerequisites, not an automatic unlock. Reference Ivo's berry knowledge record berry, nutrition 8 and toxicity 0, and owned stack item-3-ivo-30, resource berry, quantityTenths 30, quantity 3. Validate its live quantity, accessibility and condition at execution. Preparing all three units would produce one three-unit berry meal with nominal total nutrition 24 and zero recorded berry toxicity, subject to existing food-condition rules. The substantial-meal threshold is 8 nutrition; preparing food does not itself feed the actor. The observed root sources, including commons-root-5-0 and start-1-roots, are not owned ingredients: reaching and gathering them must occur separately under navigate and gather, with actual stock and energy costs. Do not expose unobserved stock. Accept positive tenths-unit quantities. Work required equals selected ingredient quantity in simulation time units at one unit per round, with energy cost 1 per ingredient unit worked; a three-unit batch therefore takes three active rounds and 3 energy, in addition to any travel, gathering, learning or eventual eating costs. Validate sufficient energy for each work increment; do not overdraw. At start atomically transfer selected quantities into a real work-in-progress container, preserving ownership, mass, provenance, nutrition, toxicity and decay history. It is a bookkeeping/product container, not a granted physical utensil. Record recipe, inputs, paid work, elapsed progress and position. Progress requires actual actor participation; no unattended preparation or review-time progress. On completion atomically replace the reserved ingredients with a portable edible prepared-food stack carrying the same total ingredient mass and food properties; no free stock or nutrition multiplier. Preserve component age/decay and use existing spoilage rules without refreshing shelf life. Fractional consumption must debit corresponding ingredient quantities and nutrition consistently. Use eat for consumption, including its 1-energy cost, existing satiety limits and actual toxicity effects; never increase basic nutrition because of mood. Interrupted work retains paid progress and real ingredients, which continue to decay. Resume only after revalidating access, condition, hands and energy. Cancellation returns the remaining real ingredient quantities and their current condition, not fresh replacements, spent energy or elapsed time. Death stops work and uses existing death/drop ownership rules for the actual unfinished food; it neither finishes the meal nor duplicates or refunds it. Spoiled or lost inputs cannot support completion. Cold prepared food has no ongoing fuel or equipment maintenance, but ordinary carrying, storage, decay and exposure rules continue. Record all transitions and executable validation rules in code; do not require repeated model approval. Implementation/review waiting advances no world time.

reviews.reason: The recorded shelter/protection search found no equivalent, and the related assembly/material search identified gathering, testing and consultation rather than construction. Reuse those existing operations where applicable; do not describe them as newly invented. The remaining search results are incomplete and no queries remain, so the current-conversation development handoff must reconcile the complete registry before adding a duplicate. A small hand-assembled shelter is a reasonable missing function. Visible fallen branches are possible sources, not owned building materials or proof of structural suitability; neither suitable roofing nor bindings are established. Development and this request provide no materials, shelter, protection or mastery. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Separate functional protection from experience. Requesting, reviewing, registering, naming and completing study earn none. This version need not add any new experience rewards: real sheltered exposure may feed the existing physical-comfort calculation, capped at 10 overall and functionally deduplicated with other protection. Never reduce basic nutrition because of mood. Personally verified new findings, including a genuinely informative failed material or site test, may use an existing information-gain rule only if it verifies actual evidence and enforces its bounded amount, per-fact deduplication, cooldown and decay; otherwise award none until such a rule is implemented. A finished structure or repeated inspection is not itself proof of pleasure or lasting satisfaction. Familiar legitimate practice may qualify for modest maintained satisfaction under an existing applicable, bounded, decaying rule; this construction operation adds no unbounded or automatic completion bonus. Other participants' feelings, consent, actions and learning are not inferred. Protected reward accounts, budget, goals and permissions remain untouched.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable, reference-bearing events for site check, reservation, each paid assembly stage, failed test, pause/resume, cancellation, commissioning, deterioration, repair and dismantling. Use reusable visual metadata keyed by project/structure ID: component type shelter, footprint, orientation, roof slope, component geometry, material appearance, roof coverage, stage, visible damage, and status unfinished/complete/unverified/unsafe. Show only actually installed components and locally observable condition. A frame has no solid roof graphic; insufficient materials, interruption or failed tests cannot show a completed shelter or protection effect. Weather shielding visuals occur only during real weather at a qualifying occupied location and reflect actual shielding; no arbitrary comfort glow or celebratory success on a failed action. Inspection findings may be presented as measured evidence without exposing hidden resource stocks.
reviews.specification:
Develop the general operation 'Assemble and maintain a simple shelter', parameterized by site, exact material allocations, project or shelter ID, and start/resume/cancel/inspect/repair/dismantle mode. Minimum executable construction: a low, single-person, braced lean-to with a sloping roof, not a house, heated room or storm shelter. Reuse gather (base:gather:1), probe (open-baseline:probe:1; handler open.probe), pickup (base:pickup:1), learn (base:learn:1), and existing navigation, inventory and process machinery; record actual code dependencies and reused handlers in the implementation. Extend physical testing only for genuinely missing measurements, not as a separate actor-specific diagnostic ability. Consultation and registry review are not physical tests.
Prerequisites: individual completed study; reachable permitted site with approximately 2 by 2 metres of clear, stable ordinary ground, outside standing water, obvious runoff channels, falling-object hazards and occupied collision space; actual suitable owned and unreserved materials within working reach. Suitability must come from observable inspection and physical tests recorded against actual material lots and the site. No hidden stock or unobserved environmental properties may be disclosed. The proposed tool-free method requires soil that permits hand insertion of forked posts to 0.3 metres and bracing that passes the stability test. If that cannot actually be done, stop with an informative failure: do not pretend a digging or cutting tool exists. This version accepts already usable pieces only; shaping, cord manufacture, harvesting roofing and tool manufacture are not bundled into assembly.
Minimum recipe: two sound forked posts, one sound ridge pole spanning approximately 2 metres, four diagonal braces, six roof ribs, 12 metres of suitable flexible binding, and 3 square metres of actual overlapping water-shedding roofing, producing at most 2 square metres of covered floor. Posts must give no more than 1.2 metres of ridge height after insertion; roof must slope at least 35 degrees and have supported overlaps and a low weather-facing edge. A branch resource unit is not automatically a pole of the right size. Record measured dimensions, mass, condition and qualification of each piece; roofing must demonstrate runoff rather than merely being called leaves. Bindings must hold their actual joins under a bounded manual pull test. Structural parts must withstand their actual roof load and the completed frame a coded lateral stability check without loosening. Missing suitable materials or failed checks block construction or commissioning; no success follows from spending time alone. Unavailable roofing need not block building an explicitly unfinished frame, but a bare frame provides no rain protection.
Costs: study 4 simulation rounds, with no material or special energy charge beyond ordinary time-dependent metabolism. Full assembly requires 12 paid work increments, each one simulation round and 1 energy: 2 for placing posts, 3 for ridge and braces, 3 for ribs and binding, 3 for laying roofing, 1 for final inspection and stability/runoff checks. Start performs at most the first increment. Assembly consumes no fuel and creates no energy. Previously necessary gathering, travel and tests are separate: gather costs 2 energy per collected resource unit and debits actual source stock; probe costs one round and 0.2 energy for observation or 0.5 energy plus 0.1 actual owned sample unit for a physical trial. Sample loss must debit the selected lot and become an explicitly recorded damaged sample or waste, not vanish or be taken from source stock. Do not charge a destructive sample cost for every installed joint: construction checks are included in their work increments. Naturally elapsed hunger and decay continue; basic nutrition is unchanged. Exact masses and stack quantities are resolved from the supplied materials before accepting the project, not inferred from these dimensional requirements.
References and accounting: each project records actor, world site coordinates and footprint, exact owned item IDs and quantities, their component lots and ages, test evidence IDs, stage, paid work, assembled components, remaining escrow and resulting structure ID. Known candidate sources are start-2-branches, forest-branch-0, canopy-41 and canopy-69; these are observation references only, not allocations or guaranteed usable poles. The owned berry stack item-3-lin-30 is not construction stock. Reserve selected inventory once; as work installs it, transfer it into persistent structure components with the same mass, condition, provenance and ownership. Do not both retain an inventory copy and create a structure copy. No automatic collection from any source. Test waste, damaged pieces, repair replacements and dismantled parts remain explicit outputs.
Progress and lifecycle: work advances only through actual paid actions in reach. Insufficient energy, movement, other actions or missing requirements pause without charging the unperformed increment; preserve paid progress and exact references. Resume revalidates site, material condition and installed stability without resetting progress or charging already completed work. Cancel takes one round and no special energy, releases surviving uninstalled reservations exactly once, and leaves installed components as a visibly unfinished structure. It does not teleport or refund installed materials. Dismantling transfers recoverable components to ground stacks at the site over one round and 1 energy per completed assembly stage removed, recording any actual damaged or irrecoverable fraction as waste. No energy, time, consumed samples or deterioration is refunded. Death ends personal work, releases uninstalled materials at their actual locations under existing death rules, and leaves installed work at the site; no automatic successor, shared mastery or consent. Another actor must independently learn, obtain legitimate access and act to continue. Global simulation pauses preserve work without ageing it; development/review waiting advances nothing.
Actual effect: only commissioned, stable and intact roofed construction can provide partial rain and wind shielding within its measured covered footprint, for at most one occupying person. Implement weather coupling in code against actual precipitation, wind direction and severity: within tested light-weather limits, reduce incident rain wetting by at most 50% and wind exposure by at most 35% on the sheltered side, never ambient temperature, hunger, nutrition or every hazard. Treat stronger conditions, uncovered positions, pooling water and wind entering the open side as outside protection; do not stack reductions from overlapping copies. Commissioning must record the supported load and protection limits. If the existing weather system lacks compatible physical units or exposure hooks, implement and test the minimal exposure hook in this same development handoff before advertising protection; meanwhile frame and roof are physical products with protection explicitly unverified. No simulated rainfall or hidden weather knowledge is manufactured to pass a test.
Maintenance and ongoing processes: while world time advances, installed materials retain their real decay and suffer coded weather damage. Protection depends on current coverage, joins and stability, not on a permanent completion flag. Reinspect after damaging weather or visible displacement; unsafe structure loses protection immediately and emits a failure/damage event. Inspection costs one round and 0.2 energy, reveals only accessible condition, and does not repair anything. Repair consumes exact replacement materials, outputs removed parts or waste, and costs one round and 1 energy per affected assembly increment; it restores only the repaired measured condition. No passive repairs, fuel, maintenance stock or automatic work are supplied. Establish these rules and tests in executable code, with transactional conservation and idempotent completion/cancellation, rather than recurrent model approval.

reviews.reason: The searched registry contains simple-shelter, but its contract explicitly permits protection for exactly one person and gives none with a second occupant. It does not cover a simultaneously shared shelter. Develop a general multi-bay assembly operation using its existing construction machinery, rather than claiming that machinery as new. Local material observations establish neither ownership nor suitability; construction cannot start from observations alone. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No benefit for requesting, naming, studying, registration or commissioning alone. Observable successful protection can produce personally applicable comfort, with total physical comfort capped at 10 and never reducing basic nutritional requirements. If the experience system supports it, actual protection during rain can give a short benefit capped at 1 per actor per 10 rounds; maintained satisfaction is capped at 1 for ongoing usable shelter access, refreshed only by actual use or maintenance and decaying at least 0.002 per round without qualifying activity. Functionally deduplicate across bays, shelter copies and equivalent comfort events. Genuine measured information gain, including a discovered leak or failed material test, may qualify once for that finding, not for repeated queries. Other users receive nothing unless they independently participate or experience the effect. Never modify protected rewards, budget, goals or permissions.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable events for material installation, stage interruption, inspection results, commissioning, leaks, repair, occupancy and dismantling. Reusable visual metadata must include structure ID, bay IDs, footprint, orientation, open approach, installed-stage mask, roof coverage, per-bay condition, commissioning status and actual occupant positions. Render partial frames and missing roof courses accurately; show protected occupancy only when runtime coverage and weather checks pass. Failed construction or tests must not display completed shelter or successful protection.
reviews.specification: Handoff: implement 'Assemble and maintain a multi-bay rain shelter', parameterized by site, orientation, exact material allocations, bay count and mode start/resume/cancel/inspect/repair/dismantle. Smallest shared version: two adjacent, independently braced lean-to bays, each with the existing 2 m x 2 m construction footprint and 2 m x 1 m covered resting floor, reached from the same unobstructed open side. Do not invent a spanning roof or remove structural members. Record code dependencies and reuse from simple-shelter, including staged assembly, provenance, roof checks, wear and exposure calculations; this is an occupancy/composition extension, not reinvention. Each bay requires 13 actual suitable branches, 4 actual suitable vines and 6 actual suitable bark units: two bays require 26, 8 and 12 respectively. Stone is not a substitute in this version. No tools are supplied or required for the existing hand-assembly method. Require reachable, clear, unoccupied, ordinary dry soil within world bounds, non-overlapping construction footprints, and an unobstructed approach wide enough for the actual users. Do not label the result universally accessible; its ridge remains 1.2 m, entry requires the actor's actual movement capabilities, and each occupant must fit wholly within one resting floor. No automatic travel, consent, construction help or occupancy for other actors. Use message for communication; each participant independently acts and pays their own applicable costs. Exact loose-source and inventory IDs must be supplied at execution; none are known for Sol's branches, bark or vines. Acquire through gather/pickup with their existing stock, distance and energy costs. Reuse probe for suitability observations or tests: one round and 0.2 energy for observation, or 0.5 energy and 0.1 real sample unit for a physical test. Testing consumes additional material, not the reserved whole construction units. No vines are currently established, so absent suitable real binding material construction pauses at the prerequisite, not at review. Study takes 4 rounds individually. Construction costs 12 one-round, one-energy increments per bay, 24 rounds and 24 energy for the two-bay version, excluding study, acquisition, travel and testing. Start pays only the first increment; energy shortages pause without charging an unperformed increment. Keep exact stage, bay, builder and material-lot progress. Reserved materials remain owned and age normally; each paid stage transfers only its listed parts into the structure without duplicating mass. Final checks commission each bay separately. A completed bay protects at most one fitting occupant; occupants in another bay must not disable this bay, but two in the same bay invalidate its protection. Apply the inherited maximum 50% rain-exposure-chill and 35% wind-exposure-chill reductions only for actual coverage, condition, orientation and wind no greater than 0.8; no shelter stacking, nutrition, air-temperature change or guaranteed rest bonus. Frames, failed checks, pooled floors and unsafe bays provide no protection. Protection tests consist of actual rain occupancy and outside/inside wetness or exposure observations; a paid wet probe can test a reachable sample or roof section but does not certify the whole shelter. Record weather and measured result, including leaks. Wear each installed part each world round by 0.0005 + 0.002*rain + 0.002*wind; condition below 0.5 disables the affected bay until replacement and passing reinspection. Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy. Builder repair costs exact replacement parts for the selected inherited stage, one round and one energy; replaced parts remain real worn ground materials. Builder dismantling costs one round and one energy per stage and returns only installed parts at current condition. Interruption preserves partial work and reservations; resume pays the next stage after revalidation. Cancel costs one round, zero energy, releases unused reservations once and leaves installed work unfinished. Death stops work, drops unused carried material at death and leaves installed parts on site. No spent time or energy is refunded. A verified new finding about viability, sprouting, failure or environmental response can support one bounded information-gain benefit, capped at 1 per actor per 10 rounds and deduplicated by finding across probe and trial interfaces. reviews.specification: Handoff: implement 'Establish and tend a cultivation trial', parameterized by visible plant/source reference, exact owned propagule lot and quantity, reachable ground site, and mode establish/tend/observe/resume/cancel/remove. Reuse probe and consult for their actual supported operations and record those dependencies; use the existing plant lifecycle and resource-transfer handlers where compatible, without claiming them as new. Initial applicable references are source start-0-roots at (10.1,12), observed stock 2 and capacity 6, and owned lot item-4-wren-46, quantity 3 with existing age and decay. Revalidate all at execution; neither source stock nor ownership is frozen by this review. The owned food's edibility is not evidence of a living crown, bud or seed. First inspect a real candidate and reachable ground using probe: observation costs one round and 0.2 energy; physical testing costs one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit, preserving or consuming the sampled amount according to the performed test. Only observed evidence is reported. If no suitable living planting unit is established, leave the owned food untouched and allow a marked monitoring trial of the existing patch; do not invent a viable propagule. Minimal planting trial selects one actual whole viable unit, or a larger exact quantity when supported, and ground that can genuinely be loosened and covered by hand. No tool, water, fertilizer or seed is provided. Establishment has three one-round stages costing one energy each: prepare a small planting position appropriate to the actual propagule, place it, then cover and record. Site area, depth and suitability must come from observed propagule dimensions and applicable lifecycle requirements, not a universal guessed root depth. If the ground cannot be worked by hand, a real suitable tool or different workable site is required. Unplaced units remain reserved, owned and ageing; placement transfers the unit's quantity, provenance, mass and remaining viable state from inventory to the trial, not to food stock. Once planted it is unavailable to eat or plant elsewhere. Observation mode costs one round and 0.2 energy and records actual changes; tending costs one round and one energy per small trial plot, with an explicit supported action such as removing an observed competing plant by hand or restoring displaced soil. Irrigation requires actual accessible water, a feasible delivery method, exact quantity and paid collection/transport; it is not a free default action. Monitoring the existing patch need not remove its food or create a second plant. Runtime must bind to the real species' supported viability, moisture, light, soil, temperature and growth rules. Use the source's existing regeneration behavior if present; do not infer a rate from its stock/capacity or disclose hidden ecological parameters. If propagation is not yet modeled, implement establishment, environmental exposure, persistent trial records and comparison against the original patch as the feasible precursor, explicitly reporting that growth and yield are unverified. No autonomous food creation is enabled until a conserved, executable lifecycle is implemented in this same development handoff. Any enabled growth must advance only with elapsed simulation time and actual required environmental inputs; record growth inputs, viable biomass, stages, mortality and harvestable output. Never replenish by copying the planting unit or resetting the source. Harvest only observed mature stock through gather, debiting that stock at its existing costs. Preserve source food properties only where species identity remains established; nutrition is obtained through eating, not planting. Record elapsed rounds, placement stage, condition, observations and interventions. At 80 elapsed trial rounds offer an inconclusive status if no decisive change has occurred; this is an observation horizon, not a maturity deadline or unlock. Continued observation is optional. Real drought, waterlogging, decay, uprooting and inadequate conditions can stall or kill a trial. Growth and deterioration proceed during ordinary world simulation, not review waiting. Interruption preserves stage and reservations; resume rechecks site, energy and material validity and pays only subsequent work. Cancel costs one round and zero energy, releases unplaced survivors once, and leaves planted material in place. Removal costs one round and one energy and returns only the material actually recoverable in its current condition, never a guaranteed edible root. Death ends personal work, drops unplaced carried units and leaves the trial subject to ecology; independent actors may interact only through their own valid actions. Spent samples, labor and time are not refunded. Each learner studies individually for 2 rounds. Encode progress, accounting and failure rules rather than repeatedly asking a model to authorize growth.
